title: S-Parameter Testbench
text: Measure S-parameters of system, {Small signal frequencies (Hz)} sets Frequencies that carry small signal transient; {Use Internal Configuration block} uses testbench internal configuration block, {Input power amplitude (dBm)} sets the input power to DUT, {Number of ports} sets the number of measured ports, {Measure all S-parameters} sets the measure entire S-parameters matrix, {Export measurement results to sNp} sets the save S-parameters data to Touchstone file, {S-Parameter elements} sets the s-parameter elements to measure, {Workspace variable name} sets the variable name to store the measurement data in MATLAB, {Input frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency, {Baseband bandwidth (Hz)} sets the baseband bandwidth of input, {Reference Impedance (Ohm)} sets the impedance for S-parameter measurement, {Show S-Parameter spectrum} sets the view measured values of specified S-parameters over the specified frequency, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the internally ground and hide RF circuit, {FFT Length} sets the number of FFT bins, {Measurement Time} sets the total time duration, {Ratio of wait time to measurement time} sets the intermission between sequential, {Ratio of Envelope to Baseband bandwidths} sets the ratio of internal solver envelope bandwidth to measured, {Adjust for steady state external signals} adjusts for large steady state signals, {Output frequency (Hz)} sets the output carrier frequency 2.1e9, {Approximate transient as small signal} sets the small subset of frequencies for transient small signal, {Use all steady-state simulation frequencies for small signal analysis} uses all frequencies automatically chosen for full-harmonic balance nonlinear and {Populate Frequencies} sets the tool to choose small signal transient frequencies. Values come from the instance.
